card.name: Inside carboxy- and -ylate chemical names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle or ending piece of a chemical name built on carboxy-, such as the 'lic' in carboxylic or the 'yle' in carboxylesterase. It also fires on 'ate' or 'late' in names like diphenoxylate or guanylate.

modes.label: Carboxy- words
modes.description: The piece right after 'carboxy' or 'carbox' in carboxylic, carboxylate or carboxylesterase.
modes.example: hydrolysis of remifentanil to its carboxy<<lic>> acid metabolite

modes.label: -ylate endings
modes.description: The 'ate' or 'late' ending of drug or molecule names such as diphenoxylate and guanylate.
